key: MOVE THE NUMBERS BETWEEN EACH SCREEN.
en: MOVE THE NUMBERS BETWEEN EACH SCREEN.
ja: 数字を各画面の間で動かせ。

key: EACH LINE THROUGH THE CENTER ON BOTH 3x3 GRIDS MUST ADD UP TO 15.
en: EACH LINE THROUGH THE CENTER ON BOTH 3x3 GRIDS MUST ADD UP TO 15.
ja: どちらの3×3のマスも、中央を通るすべての列の合計を15にせよ。

key: LINES COUNT HORIZONTALLY, VERTICALLY, AND DIAGONALLY.
en: LINES COUNT HORIZONTALLY, VERTICALLY, AND DIAGONALLY.
ja: 列は縦・横・斜めのすべてを数える。

key: EXCEPT THE CENTER, NO TWO NUMBERS CAN BE IN THE SAME POSITION ON BOTH SIDES.
en: EXCEPT THE CENTER, NO TWO NUMBERS CAN BE IN THE SAME POSITION ON BOTH SIDES.
ja: 中央を除き、同じ位置に同じ数字を両側に置くことはできない。

en: A note is slipped in between the pages:
ja: ページの間に、メモが挟まっている:
「追加の挑戦を楽しんでもらえるかもしれない。
気晴らしだと思ってくれ。」
エース: 時間を無駄にはすまい。

key: Solaris should return any moment, and it is best the message reaches him before he has more decisions to make.
en: Solaris should return any moment, and it is best the message reaches him before he has more decisions to make.
ja: ソラリス様はまもなくお戻りになるはず。これ以上の決断を下される前に、この手紙が届くのがよろしかろう。

key: ACE: "Dearest friend and commander of the stars,
en: ACE: "Dearest friend and commander of the stars,
ja: エース: 「親愛なる友、そして星々の指揮官へ、

key: Before I properly begin, I would like to iterate that I am keenly aware it is not my station to question your judgments.
en: Before I properly begin, I would like to iterate that I am keenly aware it is not my station to question your judgments.
ja: 本題に入る前に、あなた様のご判断に異を唱えることが、私の分をわきまえぬ行いであると、重々承知していることを申し上げておきたい。

key: Indeed, I hope you will kindly recall my steadfast and loyal servitude to the family throughout these many long years.
en: Indeed, I hope you will kindly recall my steadfast and loyal servitude to the family throughout these many long years.
ja: 実に、この長き年月にわたり、一家に対する私の揺るぎなき忠実な奉仕を、どうか思い起こしていただければ幸いです。

key: It is thus in mind of my prior fidelity that I urge you consider my words here not as a slight of your judgment, but as a caution of due and earned respect.
en: It is thus in mind of my prior fidelity that I urge you consider my words here not as a slight of your judgment, but as a caution of due and earned respect.
ja: ゆえに、これまでの忠義を胸に、ここに記す言葉を、あなた様のご判断への侮りとしてではなく、相応の敬意に基づく警告として受け止めていただきたく存じます。

key: If left unchecked, Lin will undo the family we've worked so tirelessly to hold together.
en: If left unchecked, Lin will undo the family we've worked so tirelessly to hold together.
ja: このまま放置すれば、リンはわれらがたゆまず守り続けてきた一家を、破壊してしまうでしょう。

key: She believes her unfailing effectuality grants her immunity, and I fear she may soon be correct.
en: She believes her unfailing effectuality grants her immunity, and I fear she may soon be correct.
ja: あの者は、己の確実な成果が免罪符になると信じており、私はそれがやがて正しくなってしまうのではと危惧しております。

key: She has made no small number of motions against our own behind the curtain for some while already.
en: She has made no small number of motions against our own behind the curtain for some while already.
ja: あの者はすでにしばらくの間、幕の裏で我々に対する少なからぬ動きを見せております。

key: She only grows bolder with the passage of time, most recently going so far as to threaten the life of your own son.
en: She only grows bolder with the passage of time, most recently going so far as to threaten the life of your own son.
ja: 時が経つにつれ、あの者はますます大胆になっており、最近ではついに、あなた様のご子息の命さえ脅かすに至りました。

key: She has no respect for all that the little prince is-- both your heir, and our hope for the greater future.
en: She has no respect for all that the little prince is-- both your heir, and our hope for the greater future.
ja: あの者は、小さな王子――あなた様の後継者であり、われらのより大いなる未来への希望であるお方――に、何の敬意も抱いておりません。

key: In fact, I believe his removal would suit her quite directly.
en: In fact, I believe his removal would suit her quite directly.
ja: 実のところ、あの方を排除することは、あの者にとって都合がよいのではとさえ思われます。

key: The family and its history are the core of our team.
en: The family and its history are the core of our team.
ja: 一家とその歴史こそが、われらのチームの核なのです。

key: Should the lineage falter, then I ask, what still gives you full control and rights beyond the shadow of a legacy?
en: Should the lineage falter, then I ask, what still gives you full control and rights beyond the shadow of a legacy?
ja: もし血筋が絶えれば、遺産の影を超えて、あなた様に完全な統率と権利を与えるものが、いったい何が残るというのでしょうか。

key: How many of our former friends still remain loyal even now?
en: How many of our former friends still remain loyal even now?
ja: かつての同志のうち、今なお忠実な者がどれほど残っているでしょうか。

key: How many are simply beside us to further their own selfish goals?
en: How many are simply beside us to further their own selfish goals?
ja: ただ己の利己的な目的のために、われらのそばにいるだけの者がどれほどいるでしょうか。

key: I beg you to take action and excise Lin from the organization before she taints it any further.
en: I beg you to take action and excise Lin from the organization before she taints it any further.
ja: どうか行動を起こし、これ以上組織が汚される前に、リンを組織から排除していただきたく懇願いたします。
切なる願いと希望を込めて、
～あなた様に永遠に忠実な愚か者、ナシラより」
エース: そして、これにて――
エース: 送信、と~
エース: ……ん?
エース: な、何だ――
